shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,240p' AGENTS.md && sed -n '1,240p' package.json && sed -n '1,240p' app/page.tsx && sed -n '1,280p' app/product/page.tsx && sed -n '1,240p' app/layout.tsx && find node_modules/next/dist/docs -maxdepth 3 -type f | sort | sed -n '1,240p'"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,280p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/instant-navigation.md && sed -n '1,320p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/streaming.md && sed -n '1,280p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/01-getting-started/04-linking-and-navigating.md && sed -n '1,280p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/01-getting-started/06-fetching-data.md && rg --files lib test tests __tests__ 2>/dev/null | sort | xargs -r -n1 sh -c 'echo \"FILE "'$0"; sed -n "1,260p" "$0"'"'"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,200p' next.config.ts; rg --files -g '*test*' -g '*spec*' -g 'vitest.config.*' -g 'tsconfig.json' -g '"'!node_modules'"' | sort; git status --short; find node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference -type f | rg 'loading|suspense|instant|cache-components|connection' | sort | sed -n '1,160p'"
/bin/bash -lc 'git status --short && git diff -- app/product/page.tsx tsconfig.json && git diff --stat'
/bin/bash -lc 'git diff --check && git diff -- app/product/page.tsx && git diff -- tsconfig.json && git status --short'

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n -o \"Premium Widget|Loading product details|in stock|Price:\" .next/server/app/product* .next/server/app/product/**/* 2>/dev/null | sed -n '1,160p'; git diff --check; git diff --name-only"
